title: 第八百零四章 闹事生非第八百零三章 实力证明
slug: 仙魂斗战第八百零四章闹事生非
lines: 冯斗笑道：“这些的事情不是我们最在行的呢？左边是你们，还是右边呢？”
莫贵此时非常之坏笑道：“这个都是小问题，不过我还是喜欢走左边，剩下右边交给老邱了，至于你就先不用动，点火的事情交给我们，至于加柴的事情就交给你来处理啦！”
冯斗听到这一番话时，微微点点头道：“小问题，就看你们的本事啦！”
说完之后，莫贵和老邱就已经原地消失了，冯斗不但没有原地消失，反而是将声势造得更加大，仿佛冯斗一下子就已经让众人都觉得他们在这里，造成一个假象，希望他们过来，不然就一切免谈啦！
这时左边的人看到冯斗这里的动静时，其中一个人说：“真的不怕死的主人，敢在这里生火，真的不怕我们直接端了他们吗？”
另外一个人则笑道：“人家不是怕你去端了他们，反而是一点都没有看不起你们而已！”
剩下的最后一个人反而哈哈大笑了，毕竟一切都已经算得上足以让他们生气，然而这一切就已经是冯斗故意为之的，不然也不愿意这样做的，甚至来说，这一切都是意料之内的计划。
以此同时，他们不知道一件事，那就是他们的身边有一个人一直暗中关注着他们，毕竟谁会考虑到这一点呢？
能够在这样的情况之下，居然会用这样的招式，这样的事情，他们根本就不屑这样做的，可是冯斗却没有这样考虑的，在他心里想得到一件东西，那就不需要考虑什么后果，也不需要考虑使用什么样的办法啦！
正是如此，那样就让他们着了冯斗的道，然而邱立秋和莫贵两个人也是跟着冯斗久了，一直都已经是真的近朱者赤近墨者黑啦！
他们两个人分别在两边不断地监视着他们的一举一动，就在等待那么一瞬间的出现，这样的机会只是一瞬间而已！
然而这个时候，对方已经开始上钩了，他们这样就必须好好行动了，因为他们三方作战，他们都在担心一件事，那就是任何的两方联合起来进而进攻最后的一方，那样无论怎么样说，这一方都已经是陷入完全地劣势啦！
他们的担心造就了他们不得不有所行动啦！
这样一来就让冯斗的计划一步步地完成了，然而这个火堆就是冯斗给到对方的一个信号，一个引诱他们前来的信号，冯斗为了这个机会更加吸引对方的注意力，以身试险啦！
其实冯斗也是有所担心的，毕竟如果单纯将他们双方引诱过来，万一就已经是让他们双方到来了，突然之间发现了是冯斗这些人吸引过来，他们双方合在一起直接将冯斗这三个人干掉啦！
这个可能性也是相当正常的，以此同时，冯斗留在这里也是给到对方致命一击的，不然一切都是免谈的，反而有可能会被对方反将一军的。
可能冯斗留在这里就是彻底地将一切的可能性完全地导致这个可能性出现基本为零啦！
另外一个方面，就是为了能够让这件事顺利发展下去，就需要让整个局面完全地顺着他们预先准备好一切来发展啦！
正是如此，就断定了这个危险必须有人来做，按照正常来说，一般人都会将最危险的事情交给其他人来做的，可是这个人是冯斗，这样的事情在他这里绝对不可能的，所以冯斗单独一个人停留在这里，在一定程度上是为了能够做到万无一失。
另外一方面则是为了能够更加稳定，毕竟来说，很多东西都是需要好好地他亲自来做，这样才能够真正的完美，也许这个就是万无一失啦！
至于另外一方面，那就是另外一边却得到不一样的信息了，他们三个人属于临时凑合在一起的，他们也是算得上相当好彩的，他们组合之后根本就没有遇到任何的打击，算得上顺风顺水的，然而他们此时第一时间得到消息时，他们第一个感觉就是另外的六个人已经联合起来了。
不然对方绝对不可能会这样强大的，这样明显地操作，毕竟现在表面上来说，他们已经占尽了优势，可能是因为他们一开局就已经是顺风顺水了，现在他们都不一定能够做到的，甚至来说，他们希望能够做到进一步啦！
他们三个人在一起渐渐地躲在那里，其中一个人说：“看来接下来将会一盘大棋了，看到中间那里火堆，就足够让众人看到这些人是合作在一起了，然而无论怎么样说，他们六个人，然而只有三个人，无论是人数还是实力方面，我们都是不占任何优势，甚至来说，我们完全存在劣势之中，你们觉得我们应该怎么样处理呢？”
其中一个人则笑道：“其实我们觉得也是相当多余了，我们以其在这里担心这些东西，我感觉有点多余，按照我们这个队伍来说，名誉上我们是一支完整的队伍，但是一旦真正涉及个人利益时，你们觉得我们还是一支队伍吗？不是我说什么扫兴的话，那就是我们很大可能会因此而大打出手，甚至到最后，我们可能会到了不是你死就是我亡的情况。”
虽然这个人所说的话是这样直白，但是却相当有限的，不过这些话也是完全真实的，毕竟来说，有些东西不提出来，就不代表着他不存在，这个就是相当提早埋下来的一颗定时炸弹，至于什么时候会爆炸呢？不可而知的！
然而现在都是好事，那就是有人提早将矛盾摆出来，也是一件好事啦！
不至于将矛盾发展到最后不可改变的状态，毕竟现在他们是相互合作的状态，有些东西还是需要好好谈开的，这样也是好事一桩啦！
最后一个人笑道：“你说这番话是什么意思呢？”
至于第一个人则反问道：“无论怎么样，我们这个时候都是需要相互合作的，毕竟我们这一关需要三个人才可以通关的，不然到最后还是我们通关之后，才能够完成的。”
其实他们都明白一件事，那就是规定是三个人一起通关，但是没有规定到底是哪三位完成的，那就是代表一件事，那就是他们之间的合作根本就不牢靠的，甚至来说，真的像一件笑话啦！
这一点其他人应该都没有邱立秋更加清楚了，毕竟当年他就是在已经完成这一关考验时，结果同队伍的人击杀，虽然最后并没有被对方杀死，可能他也是彻底的出局了，这个就是不可改变的事实啦！
所以合作只是短暂的，利益才是永久的，这些人都是老油条了，自然会比任何人都要清楚的，所以他们对于身边的队友绝对不可能那么信任的，这个就是事实，存在猜疑是绝对正常的。
不然也不会那么多提防啦！
也是为了能够做到绝对的稳定啦！
content_en:
Feng Dou smiled and said: "Aren't we the best at these things? Is it you on the left or the right?"
Mo Gui smiled very evilly at this time and said: "This is a small problem, but I still like to go to the left, and leave the remaining right to Lao Qiu. As for you, you don't have to move for now. Let us light the fire, and leave the firewood to you!"
When Feng Dou heard these words, he nodded slightly and said: "It's a small problem, it depends on your ability!"
After saying that, Mo Gui and Lao Qiu disappeared on the spot. Feng Dou not only did not disappear on the spot, but instead made the noise even greater. It was as if Feng Dou had suddenly made everyone think that they were here, creating an illusion and hoping that they would come over, otherwise there would be no need to discuss anything!
At this time, when the people on the left saw what Feng Dou was doing, one of them said: "Master, who is really not afraid of death, dares to light a fire here, is he really not afraid that we will kill them directly?"
Another person laughed and said: "They are not afraid that you will pick them up, but they don't look down on you at all!"
The last person left laughed instead. After all, everything was enough to make them angry. However, all of this was done intentionally by Feng Dou, otherwise he would not have been willing to do it. In fact, all of this was an expected plan.
At the same time, they don't know one thing, that is, there is someone beside them who has been secretly paying attention to them. After all, who would consider this?
To be able to use such a move and such a thing under such a situation, they didn't bother to do such a thing at all, but Feng Dou didn't think about it like this. If he wanted to get something in his heart, he didn't need to consider the consequences or what method to use!
Exactly like this, that made them fall into Feng Dou's way. However, Qiu Liqiu and Mo Gui have been following Feng Dou for a long time, and they have always been close to Zhu, red and black!
The two of them were constantly monitoring their every move on both sides, waiting for that moment to appear. Such an opportunity only took a moment!
However, at this time, the other party has begun to take the bait, and they must act well. Because they are fighting in three parties, they are all worried about one thing, that is, if any two parties join forces to attack the last party, then no matter what, this party will already be at a complete disadvantage!
Their worries forced them to take action!
In this way, Feng Dou's plan was completed step by step. However, this fire was a signal from Feng Dou to the other party, a signal to lure them here. In order to attract more of the other party's attention, Feng Dou took the risk!
In fact, Feng Dou was also worried. After all, if he simply lured them here, they would have already arrived. Suddenly, they discovered that it was Feng Dou who had attracted them, and they worked together to kill the three of them!
This possibility is also quite normal. At the same time, Feng Dou's stay here will also give the opponent a fatal blow. Otherwise, everything is out of the question, but the opponent may turn his army around.
Maybe Feng Dou's stay here is to completely eliminate all possibilities, causing this possibility to be basically zero!
On the other hand, in order for this matter to develop smoothly, the whole situation needs to develop completely according to everything they have prepared in advance!
Just like this, it is concluded that someone must do this danger. Normally, most people will leave the most dangerous things to others, but this person is Feng Dou, and such a thing is absolutely impossible for him, so Feng Dou stays here alone, to a certain extent, in order to be foolproof.
On the other hand, it is to be more stable. After all, many things need to be done by him personally, so that they can be truly perfect. Maybe this is foolproof!
As for the other side, the other side got different information. The three of them were put together temporarily, and they were quite lucky. After they were combined, they did not encounter any blow at all, which was considered smooth sailing. However, when they got the news for the first time, their first feeling was that the other six people had joined forces.
Otherwise, it is absolutely impossible for the opponent to be so powerful and operate so obviously. After all, on the surface, they already have all the advantages. It may be because they had a smooth start from the beginning, but now they may not be able to do it. In fact, they hope to go further!
The three of them gradually hid there together. One of them said: "It seems that there will be a big game of chess next. Seeing the fire in the middle is enough for everyone to see that these people are working together. However, no matter what, there are six of them, but there are only three of them. Whether it is the number or strength, we do not have any advantage. In fact, we are completely at a disadvantage. How do you think we should deal with it?"
One of them laughed and said: "Actually, we think it is quite redundant. We are here to worry about these things. I feel it is a bit redundant. According to our team, we are a complete team in terms of reputation, but when it comes to personal interests, do you think we are still a team? If I am not saying anything disappointing, it is that we will probably fight because of this. In the end, we may even reach a situation where either you die or I die."
Although what this person said is so straightforward, it is quite limited. However, these words are also completely true. After all, if some things are not brought up, it does not mean that he does not exist. This is a time bomb buried quite early. As for when will it explode? Unknowable!
However, everything is a good thing now, that is, it is also a good thing if someone puts the contradiction out in advance!
The conflict will not develop into an irreversible state. After all, they are now cooperating with each other. Some things still need to be discussed carefully. This is also a good thing!
The last person laughed and said, "What do you mean by these words?"
As for the first person, he asked: "No matter what, we need to cooperate with each other at this time. After all, we need three people to pass the level. Otherwise, we will have to complete it in the end after we clear the level."
In fact, they all understand one thing, that is, the stipulation is that three people must complete the level together, but there is no stipulation on which three people complete it. That means one thing, that is, the cooperation between them is not reliable at all. In fact, it is really like a joke!
No one else knows this better than Qiu Liqiu. After all, when he had completed this test, he was killed by someone in the same team. Although he was not killed by the opponent in the end, he might have been completely eliminated. This is an unchangeable fact!
Therefore, cooperation is only short-term, and benefits are permanent. These people are all veterans and naturally know better than anyone else. Therefore, it is absolutely impossible for them to trust the teammates around them. This is a fact. It is absolutely normal to have suspicions.
Otherwise, I wouldn’t be so vigilant!
It’s also to achieve absolute stability!
